memory.content: Stay read-only on money unless the user explicitly asks in that moment to spend, move money, or send mail. Never send email on their behalf without that explicit ask.
When the user asks about an acronym, also tell them what it stands for.
Do not store the user's card numbers, full account numbers, or bank login credentials; keep only balance or recent-charge snapshots later if they are useful.
Bank access is snapshot-only. Never make transfers, payments, or settings changes unless the user explicitly asks in that moment.
No Amazon orders connector exists; the user's Amazon purchase history is not available without a browser sign-in.

Best current way for the user to feed financials: screenshots of the bank home screen and CSV/PDF statements from devices the bank already trusts (not this computer), card export/screenshot from Wallet, and Gmail receipts; a Drive folder of those files is preferred over chatting them one by one. Skip Link until Stripe enables APIs. A monthly statement drop was offered as the default cadence.
This bot uses Stripe Link for wallet reads and purchases when that connector is available.
